text:
Maya: Quick UX question on the rerank batch preview viewport — in the latest build the relevance score pills have pretty low contrast on dark theme, and the export CTA copy feels ambiguous. Screenshot posted.

design-bot: ui-pr-4823 deployed with screenshot: https://ci/internal/4823/screenshot.png (preview mode)

Olivia: I can repro. Pills currently use #6B7280 on dark bg. Suggest swapping to var(--color-fg-strong) or #E5E7EB so numbers meet contrast. Also the pill bg is nearly the same as row hover which makes it hard to scan.

Jamal: Front-end note — bumping the text to var(--color-fg-strong) is trivial but it flattens the hierarchy. We could keep lighter text + slightly darker pill bg: e.g., pill-bg: rgba(255,255,255,0.06) -> 0.08.

Ankur: a11y recs: for small tokens we should aim for at least 4.5:1. If token text is 12px, contrast needs to be higher. Options: increase font-size to 13px or use #D1D5DB for text. Also keyboard focus ring disappears when table density is compact — repro steps: open batch > keyboard navigate to row > press Enter to open preview. Focus lands on Close button.

Ana: Copy suggestion: primary CTA currently says "Export vectors" but people ask if that includes embeddings + metadata. How about "Download vectors (CSV)" or "Export vectors for rerank (CSV)"? Prefer action-first.

Olivia: I prefer "Download vectors (CSV)" — concise and clear. Tooltip under CTA: "Includes id, embedding values, and metadata". For mobile we might shorten to "Download CSV".

Maya: Another behavior issue: when a preview card opens, screen readers get focus on the X close button instead of the first result title. We want initial focus on the title (or the results list) so users hear context immediately.

Jamal: Will implement initialFocus = '#preview-title' in the modal component and add aria-label to export button: "Download vectors as CSV". Also I can add a denser focus outline variable so it stays visible in compact table mode.

Ankur: Please add aria-describedby for the relevance score like: aria-describedby="relevance-score-<row>-desc" with text node "Higher number = more relevant to query". Also ensure the score element has role="status" when it updates dynamically.

Olivia: I'll push a small mock with the new pill color, slight bg tweak, updated CTA copy, and tooltip copy by EOD. Also proposing a 4px increase in left padding for the table rows to avoid visual crowding in compact mode.

Maya: :thumbsup: tiny nit — long metadata keys are truncated with no affordance. Can we add a title attribute or a hover tooltip for truncated cells? That helps support teams exporting without guessing.

Jamal: Tooltip on hover is simple; title fallback for screen readers is fine. I'll add ellipsis+title and wire up the export aria labels. Expect a PR tomorrow morning.

Ana: Great — after PR let's run a quick usability check with the analytics team on 10 recent export sessions to confirm copy clarity.

Olivia: noted. I'll add a comment in the mock about test cases: keyboard nav, screen reader flow, export label verification, and color contrast check.

Maya: Thanks everyone — once PR is merged we'll do a quick smoke on staging and close this thread.
